prompts.original: A striking visual contrast presented as a dynamic split-screen composition: on one side, silhouetted figures of traditional factory workers walking away from an old, dimly lit, industrial factory exit, symbolizing jobs being phased out. On the other side, a brightly lit, futuristic AI research lab where focused AI specialists are intensely working with holographic interfaces and advanced computers. A subtle, transparent overlay of a stylized map of Korea with glowing data points connects these two contrasting scenes, representing a nationwide job mismatch. The mood is one of transition, challenge, and a call for adaptation.
